selection_approach_display: Applicants who meet the academic requirements are ranked using their UCAT score.

course.name: Medicine and Surgery MBChB
course.notes: Five-year standard-entry course. School leavers, graduates and applicants offering approved non-traditional qualifications may apply. Graduate applicants follow separate degree and GAMSAT requirements, but A100 is not the four-year graduate-entry course.

medical_school.name: School of Medicine
medical_school.notes: Medical-school identity is represented for production metadata only; admissions logic remains in the canonical course sections.

applicant_pools.name: Home standard non-graduate UCAT ranking pool
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: ranking_model: ucat_ranking | ranking_factors: overall_ucat_total; home_sjt_band_1_to_3_gate; route_specific_academic_minimum
applicant_pools.notes: Standard Home applicants compete only within this pool. Scotland-domiciled and Rest of UK applicants use this pool unless eligible for the separate contextual pool. The live cut-off is dynamic.

applicant_pools.name: Home contextual and widening-access non-graduate UCAT ranking pool
applicant_pools.selection_relevance: ranking_model: ucat_ranking | ranking_factors: overall_ucat_total; home_sjt_band_1_to_3_gate; contextual_gcse_minimum_12; route_specific_academic_minimum
applicant_pools.notes: Eligible Home contextual applicants compete in a separate pool with a potentially lower dynamic UCAT threshold. Approximate score guidance is not a deterministic cut-off.

applicant_pools.name: International/EU non-graduate UCAT ranking pool
applicant_pools.notes: SJT is not used for International/EU assessment. The 23 figure is the current International/EU A100 place cap, not a non-graduate-only allocation.

applicant_pools.name: Graduate A100 GAMSAT ranking pool
applicant_pools.notes: The canonical selection-model vocabulary has no GAMSAT-specific model, so ranking_model remains null. Applicants pass the academic and GAMSAT section gates, then rank by overall GAMSAT. Degree quality may be considered for tied scores, but no exact tie-break formula is published. Contextual UCAT adjustments do not apply.

applicant_pools.name: Home fee-status offer pool
applicant_pools.notes: Routine offers are ranked by MMI score only. UCAT, GCSE score and predicted grades are not routinely reused. Borderline review may use contextual data and the full application profile.

applicant_pools.name: International/EU fee-status offer pool
applicant_pools.notes: The place cap and offer pool are separate from Home. Exact over-offering and interview cut-off management are not published.

overall_policy.description: Liverpool first ranks applicants by the route-specific admissions test, then applies the route-specific academic screen, repeating those stages until interviews are allocated. Non-graduates rank by UCAT cognitive total and graduates rank by overall GAMSAT after the section gate. Access and international qualifications use explicit Liverpool-verification gates; unverified qualifications are blocked rather than inferred.
not_eligible_if: The applicant does not take the required admissions test for their applicant route.
A Home non-graduate UCAT applicant has SJT Band 4.
The applicant does not meet the published minimum academic requirements for their qualification route.
Required application information or requested evidence is not supplied within the stated timeframe.

grade_requirements.notes: English Language is a core subject.
Biology is required unless an accepted combined/core and additional/dual/triple science alternative supplies the science requirement.
Chemistry is required unless an accepted combined/core and additional/dual/triple science alternative supplies the science requirement.

accepted_equivalencies.value: Core and Additional Science, combined science, dual science or triple science may replace separate Biology and Chemistry where the published minimum grade is met.
Applicants with limited or no GCSE/IGCSE results must submit Year 10 and/or Year 11 transcripts or alternative qualifications for individual assessment.

gcse.sitting_policy: Normally nine separate subjects attained by the end of Year 11. Core-subject resits may be considered under the separate resit policy.

points_by_result.qualification_or_grade: BTEC non-science Level 2 or OCR award at Distinction*/Distinction
BTEC non-science Level 2 or OCR award at Merit

rules: No more than two points are awarded in one subject area.
Only one of Mathematics and Further Mathematics contributes.
Dual Award GCSEs normally contribute at most two points, except Dual Science can contribute up to four points.
Triple Science can contribute up to six points.
Short-course GCSEs receive at most half the points of a full GCSE, while two short courses may replace one full GCSE.
No more than two Level 2 BTEC qualifications or OCR awards count within the nine GCSEs/equivalents.
BTEC/OCR awards cannot replace English Language, Mathematics or the required sciences, leaving a minimum of seven full GCSEs.

mature_applicant_exception.conditions: Some mature adults returning to education may be considered with at least five GCSEs at grade 6/B because of other achievements. Individual eligibility is not fully specified and must not be inferred.

gcse.selection_role: Minimum eligibility and GCSE points threshold. For non-graduates, higher GCSE scores may be preferred in borderline decisions; no weighted academic formula is published.
gcse.notes: Predicted school-level grades are not used for non-graduate selection. The standard nine-GCSE and 15-point rules should not be automatically applied to mature applicants or applicants without a conventional GCSE set without route-specific review.

national_5.sitting_policy: Required subjects must be attained by the end of S4.
national_5.notes: Seven National 5/Intermediate 2 subjects are required by the end of S4: Biology, Chemistry, English Language, Mathematics and at least three other subjects. Physics is not mandatory. The official rule does not specify a separate minimum grade, so the engine checks subject presence and does not invent one.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required alongside Chemistry.

grade_requirements.notes: A third academic subject is also required.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: The A* and A grades must be in Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics, in either order.

grade_requirements.notes: The third academic subject must be grade B.

standard_offer.notes: Chemistry plus one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics and a third academic subject.

contextual_offer.notes: No automatic Liverpool A100 contextual A-level reduction is applied. Liverpool Scholars and Liverpool Pathways have separately published likely offer guidance.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required alongside Chemistry.

a_level.third_subject_rules: A third academic subject is required. The Advanced Welsh Baccalaureate Skills Challenge Certificate is accepted in place of the third academic subject. Only one of Mathematics and Further Mathematics is considered.
a_level.sitting_policy: Three A levels taken in one sitting after a two-year period of study.
a_level.predicted_grades_selection_role: Pending qualifications are accepted, but predicted school-level grades are not used to rank non-graduate applicants.

one_of_hl_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required at Higher Level alongside Chemistry.

grade_requirements.notes: A third academic Higher Level subject is required. Standard Level 5,5,5 is required in subjects not offered at Higher Level.

one_of_hl_subject_groups.notes: The grades 7 and 6 must be in Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics, in either order.

grade_requirements.notes: The third academic Higher Level subject must be grade 5. Standard Level 5,5,5 is required in subjects not offered at Higher Level.

one_of_hl_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required at Higher Level alongside Chemistry.

ib.notes: The standard GCSE/equivalent core-subject and point requirements also apply. Applicants with at least 12 GCSE points may be considered if they have already achieved 36 IB points in the required subject pattern.

higher_offer.notes: Five Highers taken at one sitting after one year of study.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Advanced Highers in Chemistry and one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required alongside Chemistry.

grade_requirements.notes: Five Highers must be taken at one sitting after one year of study.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required alongside Chemistry.

grade_requirements.notes: The Scottish Science Baccalaureate is not by itself sufficient.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: One of Biology, Physics or Mathematics is required alongside Chemistry.

scottish.notes: Post-16 Scottish requirements are verified. National 5 eligibility is executable without Physics and without an invented grade threshold.

btec.notes: BTEC Level 3 National Extended Diploma is not accepted in place of A levels, and Level 3 BTECs are not considered as the third A-level subject. Qualifying non-science Level 2 BTEC/OCR awards may contribute to GCSE points under the separate GCSE rule.

access_to_he.notes: Only Liverpool-approved Access to Medicine or MSC Access to HE Medicine pathways are routed. The applicant record must confirm both provider approval and that the provider-specific requirements are met. Unverified or unlisted Access routes are explicitly blocked. APL and APEL are not usually accepted.

international_qualifications.notes: Country qualifications route only when Liverpool has verified the equivalence and minimum requirements. Unlisted qualifications, missing transcripts or unresolved equivalence are explicitly blocked rather than mapped by inference.

degree.alternative_requirement: A minimum 2:2 undergraduate degree or integrated Master's degree in any subject plus an achieved or predicted postgraduate Master's or PhD.
degree.notes: A degree may be achieved or predicted for an applicant in or about to enter the final year. International graduates may apply to A100 only; Home graduates may apply to A100 and A101.

graduate_policy.definition: An applicant already awarded an undergraduate degree or in the final year with the degree award pending.
academic_options: Minimum 2:1 Honours degree or integrated Master's degree in any subject.
Minimum 2:2 undergraduate degree or integrated Master's degree in any subject plus an achieved or predicted postgraduate Master's or PhD.
graduate_policy.notes: Graduate applicants use a distinct GAMSAT ranking branch within A100 selection.

post_16.notes: A-level, IB, Scottish, approved Access to Medicine, Liverpool-verified international-equivalence and graduate A100 routes are implemented. Unsupported or unverified qualification routes return an explicit block and are never inferred.

ucat.ranking_score: overall UCAT cognitive total; individual cognitive subtests are not separately ranked
ucat.validity_window: UCAT taken in 2026 for application in 2026 and entry in 2027
ucat.notes: UCAT is compulsory for all non-graduate A100 applicants. The live Home and International/EU cut-offs vary annually and are not known in advance. Significant inability to sit must be raised with Liverpool before testing closes; no automatic exemption or replacement score is published.

group_policies.notes: Home applicants with Band 4 are unsuccessful.
International/EU applicants may offer any band and SJT is not used in assessment.

sjt.notes: The top-level accepted/excluded bands express the Home rule. International/EU applicants follow the separate group policy. SJT is not applicable to graduate GAMSAT selection.

other_tests.name: Graduate Medical School Admissions Test
other_tests.ranking_score: overall GAMSAT score after every sub-component meets 50
other_tests.tie_break_guidance: Academic classification or degree quality may be considered when overall GAMSAT scores are tied, but no exact formula is published.
other_tests.notes: An overall score of 55 has been competitive or minimum guidance in previous years, but no fixed 2027 overall threshold is published.

conditions: Core GCSE resits may be considered where the applicant otherwise has the required points from the remaining GCSE subjects taken by the end of Year 11.
A-level resit applicants are normally considered only where at least ABB was achieved at first sitting.
A-level resit applicants must complete the applicant online form; any offer is usually higher than AAA, with A*AA given as an example.
Scottish resit applicants are normally expected to have achieved at least BB at Advanced Higher at first sitting; a resit offer may be higher than the standard requirement.
IB resit applicants normally need at least 34 points at first sitting and must meet the applicable GCSE criteria.
Extenuating circumstances must be documented through the applicant online form and academic reference.
After an unsuccessful A100 application, only one further consecutive application may normally be made.
resits.notes: Resit eligibility and any higher offer are route-specific. No general maximum number of resits is published.

exemptions: Applicants from a majority English-speaking country may not need to demonstrate English through IELTS; eligibility must follow the University policy.
english_language.notes: The checked 2027 Medicine evidence identifies IELTS 7.0 overall with no component below 7.0. Other English-language qualifications are not implemented.

age_or_professional_checks.minimum_age_date: 1 October in the year of entry
age_or_professional_checks.notes: Accepted applicants must be 18 by 1 October 2027. The course page states that enhanced criminal-record and occupational-health checks and infectious-disease testing or immunisation apply before patient contact.

personal_statement.notes: Experiences described may inform assessment of non-academic attributes at interview.

academic_reference.notes: References may support documented extenuating circumstances.

work_experience.notes: No minimum work experience is specified. Applicants are expected to demonstrate or develop relevant non-academic attributes.

non_academic.notes: Health-care awareness, community care, communication and values underpinning good health-care practice are assessed through the process, particularly interview.

selection_sequence.description: Rank applicants by UCAT cognitive total for non-graduates or overall GAMSAT for graduates after the GAMSAT section gate.
Apply the route-specific minimum academic screen. Stages 1 and 2 repeat until interview capacity is allocated.
Rank eligible applicants from highest to lowest within the relevant separate pool by UCAT cognitive total only for non-graduates or total GAMSAT score for graduates.
Issue interview invitations by rank until the relevant pool's capacity is filled.

academic_scoring.notes: GCSE score above the applicable minimum, A-level predictions, personal statement, references and work experience are not scored in routine non-graduate pre-interview ranking. No combined academic-plus-UCAT formula applies.

ranking_factors.notes: Eligible non-graduate applicants are ranked from highest to lowest by UCAT cognitive total only within the Home standard, Home contextual or International pool. The live cut-off varies by pool and is unknown in advance.
Graduate applicants meeting at least 50 in every GAMSAT sub-component are ranked by overall score.
Academic requirements act as an eligibility screen before admissions-test ranking and do not contribute points to routine non-graduate ranking.

score_components.notes: UCAT cognitive total is the complete routine ranking score. Academic and SJT points are not added. The number progressed and live cut-off are dynamic.
No fixed competitive 2027 overall GAMSAT threshold is published.

total_score.notes: The components are alternative applicant-route branches, not additive components. Academic screening and admissions-test filters occur before ranking.

calculation.notes: The verified method supports UCAT guidance confidence bands for A100 non-graduates. It does not support a deterministic interview probability or current-cycle pass/fail threshold.

thresholds.notes: The live cut-off varies annually. Official candidate guidance places the typical Home range in applicant-pool deciles 4 to 6, but those deciles are not executable without the live pool distribution. The E2025 cutoff of 1935 is stored as historical guidance only.
The live contextual cut-off varies annually. The FOI-verified E2025 contextual cutoff of 1733 is historical guidance only; Home SJT Band 4 remains a hard rejection.

The live cut-off varies annually. Official candidate guidance places the typical International range in applicant-pool deciles 7 to 9, but those deciles are not executable without the live pool distribution. The E2025 cutoff of 2108 is stored as historical guidance only.
Applicants meeting the component minimum are ranked by overall GAMSAT score.

bands.definition: At or above the applicable FOI-verified E2025 historical cutoff.
Below the applicable FOI-verified E2025 historical cutoff without crossing an official hard rejection rule.
The applicant route or evidence does not support a safe guidance band.

guidance_prediction.notes: Only the three FOI-verified E2025 cutoffs are executable as historical guidance boundaries. No unofficial likely/high-risk numeric boundaries are used. Bands are not current-cycle pass/fail thresholds or probability estimates.

selection_adjustments.notes: The live contextual threshold is determined annually. Only the FOI-verified E2025 cutoff is retained as historical guidance. Home SJT Band 4 remains unsuccessful.

interview_format.cross_format_comparison: A percentage interview score is generated to compare interview formats within the relevant fee-status cohort.
interview_format.same_structure_and_criteria: Likely to be the same for all A100 applicants, according to the departmental supplement.
interview_format.scoring_rubric: Seven equally weighted stations scored zero to five. Detailed behavioural anchors are not published in the supplied evidence.
interview_format.notes: Values Based Recruitment and Selecting for Excellence principles apply. Delivery plans may change.

output_band_policy.notes: Guidance bands may be assigned only for supported A100 non-graduate pools and must be labelled non-deterministic. No probability percentage, fixed current-cycle cut-off or final-offer prediction may be produced.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: The selection sequence and UCAT-only ranking inputs are verified. Guidance confidence bands are supported at medium confidence; exact interview probability remains unavailable because live cut-offs and pool distributions are dynamic.

criteria.description: UK Home applicant from a socio-economically deprived postcode area in Index of Multiple Deprivation decile 1 or 2.
criteria.notes: Liverpool IMD Deciles 1-2 are represented in ApplySmart by canonical IMD Quintile 1.

criteria.description: UK applicant who has spent any amount of time in local-authority care and meets nationally used eligibility criteria.
criteria.notes: Care-experienced applicants can qualify for Liverpool Medicine contextual consideration. This does not guarantee an interview, offer or reduced A-level offer.

adjustments.policy_description: Eligible applicants are expected to offer at least 12 GCSE points rather than the standard 15.
adjustments.notes: The contextual GCSE points threshold is 12 rather than 15 for confirmed Liverpool contextual applicants. Mandatory GCSE subject and grade requirements remain independently enforced.

adjustments.policy_description: Reduced UCAT performance may receive individual additional consideration.
adjustments.notes: The live threshold is determined annually. Guidance is not deterministic. Home SJT Band 4 remains unsuccessful, and this adjustment does not apply to GAMSAT.

adjustments.policy_description: Reduced interview performance may receive individual additional consideration.
adjustments.notes: Flexibility is determined annually after all scores are available and does not guarantee an offer.

named_programme_offer_guidance.subject_rule: The A must be in Chemistry, Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
At least one A must be in Chemistry, Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

contextual_admissions.notes: The medicine-specific contextual policy applies to eligible Home non-graduate applicants and excludes graduate and mature applicants. The GCSE threshold is 12 points and pre-interview applicants rank in a separate contextual pool. UCAT lowering remains guidance only, interview flexibility remains numerically unpublished, Home SJT Band 4 is still rejected and no contextual adjustment applies to GAMSAT.

offer_selection.interview_format: Multiple Mini Interview; Home applicants are expected to interview face to face on campus and International applicants through an equivalent online MMI.

interview_scoring.notes: Seven equally weighted stations are scored zero to five, then represented as a percentage for cohort comparison. The detailed behavioural anchors, annual norm-referenced pass mark and offer threshold are unpublished.

ranking_factors.notes: Routine post-interview ranking uses MMI score only. UCAT, GCSE score and predicted grades are not routinely reused.

possible_factors: other relevant academic or non-academic information
interviewer concerns outside the stated marking criteria
ranking_factors.notes: These are the official borderline factors. They are not weighted and must not be converted into a score.

tie_break_hierarchy.method: Rank overall MMI interview scores and offer to the top-scoring applicants unless an issue of concern is recorded.
For borderline decisions, consider the official combination of academic achievement or potential, admissions-test performance, interview score and contextual information.
Consider other relevant academic or non-academic information available to the Admissions Tutor, including recorded interviewer concerns.

waiting_list_policy.notes: No waiting-list method is used by the offer model.

standard_offer.notes: Subject requirements remain Chemistry plus one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics and a third academic subject. For A*AB, the A* and A must be in the two required science/mathematics subjects.

contextual_offer.notes: No automatic Liverpool A100 contextual A-level reduction is applied. Liverpool Scholars and Pathways have named likely offer profiles stored under contextual admissions.

offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction is disabled. Only the official MMI ranking method and official borderline decision hierarchy are stored. No annual pass mark, offer boundary, weights or probability are inferred.

application_context.admissions_test_resits: Applicants may retake UCAT or GAMSAT where permitted by the route-specific policy.
application_context.notes: The application deadline and repeat-application rules remain eligibility context, not prediction factors.

cycles.ucat_score_scale: pre-2025 four-cognitive-subtest UCAT total out of 3600
cycles.notes: Approximate historical context only. Scores on the /3600 scale are not directly comparable with the /2700 scale used from 2025 and must not be converted into a current threshold.

cycles.notes: Approximate historical context only. Scores on the /3600 scale are not directly comparable with the /2700 scale used from 2025 and must not be converted into a current threshold.

cycles.notes: FOI-confirmed historical confidence-band context only. These values must not be reused as current-cycle deterministic thresholds.

cycles.ucat_score_scale: post-2025 three-cognitive-subtest UCAT total out of 2700
cycles.notes: A100 places are official E2026 intake values. Application, interview, offer, deferred/reserved and UCAT figures are approximate historical guidance and must not become deterministic rules.

current_cycle_guidance.notes: E2026 estimates and guidance only. These ranges are not live or guaranteed thresholds, and performance and competition vary annually.

gamsat_policy_context.overall_55_guidance: minimum or competitive guidance where officially supported, not a fixed live cut-off
gamsat_policy_context.notes: No Section III, Section I or Section II tie-break order is implemented because the supplied evidence does not explicitly confirm it.

related_route_context.notes: A101 and A104 figures are retained as related-route context only and are excluded from A100 eligibility and prediction logic.
